notes_for_editor: Two records only: the tnlandforms tower list (NCT225) and the NGS station list (FW1620), which share the same coordinates and name the station COREYS LOOKOUT TOWER. Neither gives a build date, design, height, staffing, agency or present condition. The NGS XX codes flag the survey marker, not the tower. Do not confuse with the NHLR Currituck Fire Tower (US 1703, NC 29), a separate privately owned 100 ft Aermotor about 12 km to the south-west (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/nc/currituck-fire-tower/); the story does not mention it. The brief's NGS register entry is a geodetic listing, not a lookout register. Two search calls were used for this tower; neither turned up another source.
